Bring every client with you See how importing works Product Pricing Integrations Customers Company About Blog Contact Overview Buy Brightlight Company September 24, 2026 Why we built invoicing for people who bill alone Accounting tools are made for companies with a finance team. Most freelancers just want to send the invoice and get on with the work. Ruggero Fantoni Co-founder Before Brightlight, I spent eight years as a freelance designer. I was good at the work and bad at the money. Invoices went out late, reminders went out never, and every April I found out how much tax I owed at the worst possible moment. The tools were built for someone else Every invoicing tool I tried assumed a finance team. Approval flows, purchase orders, cost centres. I needed none of it. I needed a clean invoice with my name on it, sent the day the work was done, and a nudge
